'''Zo'ssa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was a pilot in the Rebel alliance and would often smuggle objects from planets with an Imperial blockade.<ref name="Galaxies" />
